items.text: Merrill announced the launch of two new services, the Tax Efficient Transition Service (TET) and the Dollar Cost Averaging Service (DCA), which combine automation with professional portfolio oversight to help clients simplify asset transitions and cash deployment into managed or custom managed strategies in the Merrill Lynch Investment Advisory Program (IAP).
items.quote: Merrill today announced the launch of Tax Efficient Transition Service (TET) and Dollar Cost Averaging Service (DCA), new services that combine automation with professional portfolio oversight to help clients simplify asset transitions and cash deployment into managed or custom managed investment strategies in the Merrill Lynch Investment Advisory Program (IAP).

items.text: Merrill said both services are optional, carry no additional IAP Program Fees, are available through the IAP, and are implemented by Managed Account Advisors LLC (MAA).
items.quote: Both services are optional and available to clients, with no additional IAP Program Fees charged. They are available through IAP and are implemented by Managed Account Advisors LLC (MAA), Merrill’s centralized team that helps implement and manage portfolio solutions on behalf of clients and advisors.

items.text: Merrill's TET service lets clients move appreciated securities (individual equities, eligible mutual funds and ETFs) into a managed strategy gradually while managing capital gains realization, and its DCA service invests cash into eligible managed strategies on a client-selected schedule.
items.quote: TET is a service designed to help clients transition appreciated securities into a managed investment strategy over time. ... DCA is a service that gradually invests cash into a managed investment strategy according to a client-selected schedule.

items.text: Merrill offers an Advisor Development Program for people seeking a wealth-management career, with staged roles (ADP Client Associate, ADP Financial Solutions Advisor, ADP Financial Advisor) progressing to Merrill Core Advisor, including licensing study time and coaching.
items.quote: If you’re interested in a career in wealth management and possess the entrepreneurial spirit - the Advisor Development Program is for you. ... After mastering key objectives and pre-determined targets, progress through three roles until you graduate to Merrill Core Advisor.

items.text: Merrill points to a client-first planning process powered by Merrill-exclusive planning technology and analytics, and to a suite of user-friendly tools and resources designed to streamline an advisor's practice.
items.quote: A client-first planning process, powered by Merrill exclusive planning technology and powerful analytics to visualize your finances ... Suite of state-of-the-art, user-friendly tools and resources designed to streamline your practice

items.text: Bank of America's CFO cited advisor productivity, disciplined pricing, digital engagement and AI tools as expanding the segment's capacity to deliver personalized advice at scale.
items.quote: Advisor productivity, disciplined pricing, digital engagement and AI tools continue to expand our capacity to deliver personalized advice at scale.

items.text: Merrill advertises robust solutions for ultra-high-net-worth clients, including alternative investments and sustainable and impact investing strategies, alongside access to Merrill's wealth management platform and Bank of America's banking and trust capabilities.
items.quote: Access to Merrill's wealth management platform and Bank of America's banking and trust capabilities ... Robust solutions for ultra-high-net-worth clients, including alternative investments and sustainable and impact investing strategies

cells.reason: The passages describe specific Merrill services and platforms (TET, DCA in the IAP, Advisor Development Program, planning technology, AI/digital tools, alternatives and impact strategies) offered to clients and advisors.
